content.title: Teyana Taylor Reacts to Amy Madigan’s Oscars Win in Shared Category | Oscars 2026
content.text: After Amy Madigan was named the 2026 Oscar winner for Best Supporting Actress, her fellow nominee Teyana Taylor was among the first to celebrate the ‘Weapons’ star's achievement. While onstage Amy—who was last nominated for an Oscar in 1986—shared insight into her award season journey, crediting her fellow Best Supporting Actress nominees, ‘One Battle After Another’ star Teyana, ‘Sinners’ star Wunmi Mosaku and ‘Sentimental Value’ stars Elle Fanning and Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas for the sisterhood they’ve developed over the last few months. She explained, “When I was doing all the ‘Weapons’ stuff, I was kinda traveling on my own, and people from ‘One Battle’ and people from ‘Sinners’ just kind of gave me a hug and said come on in.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1429094/... #enews #teyanataylor #oscars About: The E!
